sloka: क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथं च मयि वर्तते ।एतन्मे सर्वमाख्यात वैदेहीं प्रति वानराः ।। ५.६५.५ ।।।।
transliteration: kva sītā vartate devī kathaṁ ca mayi vartate ।etanme sarvamākhyāta vaidehīṁ prati vānarāḥ ।। 5.65.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.
